description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Complete Set of Heater Control Wires.
These mount to the back of the control arms and control the various functions of the air system.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Wire, Water Valve Control (Heat)
Qty 1 – Wire, Circulation/Fresh Air
Qty 1 – Wire, Room/Defrost Control
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
